description:
**TSP multifragment construction with exact bounded-window reordering.** Use a symmetric complete distance matrix. Greedy multifragment construction supplies the initial open tour.

Pass a nonwrapping window of consecutive internal vertices to exact subset dynamic programming, with the immediately preceding and following vertices fixed. Replace the window only when the full boundary-to-boundary path improves. Repeat over windows for at most the requested passes.

Window size is bounded between two and eight. This is a small subchain adaptation of an exact TSP neighborhood. It improves a restricted neighborhood while preserving every outside edge and the full tour.
